01-landing.jpg.name: landing
01-landing.jpg.about: The first page at "/" before any photo is chosen.
01-landing.jpg.see: Yellow word "MOVE THE LIGHT", the heading "Relight a photo by dragging the light.", a dashed box "Drop a photo here", then "Or try a sample photo:" and four thumbnails: Portrait, Coffee cup, Cat, Rocket. Top right pill: amber dot, "backend: online, mock providers".

02-upload-empty.jpg.name: upload-empty
02-upload-empty.jpg.about: The same empty upload page at "/relight", with the mouse resting on the dashed drop box.
02-upload-empty.jpg.see: The same page at the address /relight. The dashed drop box is a little lighter because the mouse is on it.

03-scene-loading.jpg.name: scene-loading
03-scene-loading.jpg.about: Just after choosing a photo, while the backend is still working out depth and normals.
03-scene-loading.jpg.see: The photo is dimmed with a pill "Estimating depth and surface normals…" in the middle. The whole sidebar is faded, the "Sweep", "Enhance", "Hold to see original" and "Export PNG" buttons are greyed out, and the GEOMETRY row has no thumbnails yet. There is no sun on the photo.

04-scene-default-light.jpg.name: scene-default-light
04-scene-default-light.jpg.about: Portrait photo loaded, nothing touched: the light is at its starting place.
04-scene-default-light.jpg.see: The round white sun is on the flag at the left edge, about a third of the way down. Readouts: x 0.12, y 0.35, Height 0.12, Intensity 1.80, Ambient 0.06, Colour neutral, Cast shadows on. The left side of the face (your left) is bright and the right cheek is in shadow; the right of the picture is darker than the left.

05-scene-all-panels.jpg.name: scene-all-panels
05-scene-all-panels.jpg.about: The same loaded scene in a taller window (1440 x 1300): the LIGHT and ENHANCE panels and the folded GEOMETRY row, with room to spare.
05-scene-all-panels.jpg.see: The same picture and readouts in a taller window. LIGHT, ENHANCE and the one-row GEOMETRY panel (two tiny thumbnails, "Show", down arrow) all show, with empty space under them.

06-preset-left.jpg.name: preset-left
06-preset-left.jpg.about: Portrait photo after clicking the "Left" preset button.
06-preset-left.jpg.see: The sun is outside the photo on the left, a little above the middle. Readouts: x -0.10, y 0.40, Height 0.35, Intensity 1.30, Ambient 0.06. The left of the face and suit is bright; the right cheek is in soft shadow.

07-preset-right.jpg.name: preset-right
07-preset-right.jpg.about: Portrait photo after clicking the "Right" preset button.
07-preset-right.jpg.see: The sun is outside the photo on the right. Readouts: x 1.10, y 0.40, Height 0.35, Intensity 1.30. The right side of the face and the helmet are bright; the left half of the face is dark.

08-preset-top.jpg.name: preset-top
08-preset-top.jpg.about: Portrait photo after clicking the "Top" preset button.
08-preset-top.jpg.see: The sun is above the photo in the middle, at the very top of the dark stage. Readouts: x 0.50, y -0.07 (the preset asks for -0.15; the stage stops it at -0.07 in this window), Height 0.35, Intensity 1.30. The hair and forehead are bright; under the chin is dark.

09-preset-low-and-warm.jpg.name: preset-low-and-warm
09-preset-low-and-warm.jpg.about: Portrait photo after clicking the "Low and warm" preset button.
09-preset-low-and-warm.jpg.see: The sun is orange-tinted at the bottom left corner of the photo. Readouts: x 0.00, y 0.90, Height 0.12, Intensity 1.60, Ambient 0.20, Colour warm 100, and the colour dot is pale orange. The whole picture has a warm orange cast and the face is lit from below.

10-drag-far-left.jpg.name: drag-far-left
10-drag-far-left.jpg.about: Portrait photo with the sun handle dragged with the mouse to the left edge of the photo, half way down.
10-drag-far-left.jpg.see: The sun sits on the left edge of the photo, half way down. Readouts: x 0.03, y 0.50; the sliders are still at their starting values (0.12, 1.80, 0.06). The left of the face is bright, the right cheek dark.

11-drag-far-right.jpg.name: drag-far-right
11-drag-far-right.jpg.about: Portrait photo with the sun handle dragged with the mouse to the right edge of the photo, half way down.
11-drag-far-right.jpg.see: The sun sits on the right edge of the photo, half way down. Readouts: x 0.97, y 0.50. The right of the face and the white helmet rim are bright; the left half of the face is dark.

12-drag-top.jpg.name: drag-top
12-drag-top.jpg.about: Portrait photo with the sun handle dragged with the mouse to the top edge of the photo, in the middle.
12-drag-top.jpg.see: The sun sits on the top edge of the photo in the middle, on the hair. Readouts: x 0.50, y 0.03. The hair glows; the face below it is evenly lit.

13-drag-outside-photo.jpg.name: drag-outside-photo
13-drag-outside-photo.jpg.about: Portrait photo with the sun handle dragged with the mouse to the dark area to the right of the photo (outside the picture).
13-drag-outside-photo.jpg.see: The sun is on the dark stage to the right of the photo, next to the sidebar. Readouts: x 1.21, y 0.30 (as far right as the stage allows). The lighting looks like the Right preset: right side bright, left half of the face dark.

14-drag-centre.jpg.name: drag-centre
14-drag-centre.jpg.about: Portrait photo with the sun handle dragged with the mouse to the middle of the photo, on the neck ring just under the chin.
14-drag-centre.jpg.see: The sun is in the middle of the photo on the metal neck ring. Readouts: x 0.50, y 0.45. The neck ring and chest near the sun are brightest; the face is dimmer than in the other shots because the light is low and below it.

15-height-min.jpg.name: height-min
15-height-min.jpg.about: Portrait photo, "Left" preset clicked, then the Height slider moved all the way left (0.03).
15-height-min.jpg.see: Left preset with Height 0.03 (slider fully left). The light skims the surface: the picture is darker overall, with strong shadows across the face and suit.

16-height-max.jpg.name: height-max
16-height-max.jpg.about: Portrait photo, "Left" preset clicked, then the Height slider moved all the way right (2.00).
16-height-max.jpg.see: Left preset with Height 2.00 (slider fully right). The light is far in front: the whole picture is evenly lit, almost like the original photo.

17-intensity-low.jpg.name: intensity-low
17-intensity-low.jpg.about: Portrait photo, "Left" preset clicked, then the Intensity slider moved all the way left (0.00).
17-intensity-low.jpg.see: Left preset with Intensity 0.00 (slider fully left). The picture is very dark but still visible, lit only by the Ambient 0.06.

18-intensity-high.jpg.name: intensity-high
18-intensity-high.jpg.about: Portrait photo, "Left" preset clicked, then the Intensity slider moved all the way right (4.00).
18-intensity-high.jpg.see: Left preset with Intensity 4.00 (slider fully right). The picture is very bright; the flag, the suit and the left of the face are close to white.

19-ambient-low.jpg.name: ambient-low
19-ambient-low.jpg.about: Portrait photo, "Left" preset clicked, then the Ambient slider moved all the way left (0.00).
19-ambient-low.jpg.see: Left preset with Ambient 0.00 (slider fully left). Shadows are pure black: the right cheek and the right of the picture are darker than in 06-preset-left.

20-ambient-high.jpg.name: ambient-high
20-ambient-high.jpg.about: Portrait photo, "Left" preset clicked, then the Ambient slider moved all the way right (1.00).
20-ambient-high.jpg.see: Left preset with Ambient 1.00 (slider fully right). No dark shadows are left; the picture is bright and flat.

21-colour-warm.jpg.name: colour-warm
21-colour-warm.jpg.about: Portrait photo, "Left" preset clicked, then the Colour slider moved all the way right (warm 100).
21-colour-warm.jpg.see: Left preset with Colour "warm 100" (slider fully right). The sun handle and the colour dot are pale orange and the whole picture has an orange tint.

22-colour-cool.jpg.name: colour-cool
22-colour-cool.jpg.about: Portrait photo, "Left" preset clicked, then the Colour slider moved all the way left (cool 100).
22-colour-cool.jpg.see: Left preset with Colour "cool 100" (slider fully left). The sun handle and the colour dot are pale blue and the whole picture has a blue tint.

23-shadows-on.jpg.name: shadows-on
23-shadows-on.jpg.about: Object photo, "Left" preset, Height 0.10, Cast shadows ON (the default).
23-shadows-on.jpg.see: Coffee cup, sun at the left edge (x -0.04, y 0.40), Height 0.10, Cast shadows on. The cup throws a dark, soft-edged shadow to the right across the saucer and the spoon.

24-shadows-off.jpg.name: shadows-off
24-shadows-off.jpg.about: Exactly the same light as shadows-on, with the Cast shadows switch turned OFF.
24-shadows-off.jpg.see: The same light with the Cast shadows switch off (grey, knob on the left). The dark shadow to the right of the cup is gone; the saucer and spoon on the right are lit.

25-detailed-normals-on.jpg.name: detailed-normals-on
25-detailed-normals-on.jpg.about: Portrait photo, "Left" preset, GEOMETRY panel opened, Detailed normals ON (the default). Look at the Normals thumbnail.
25-detailed-normals-on.jpg.see: The sidebar is scrolled to the bottom. GEOMETRY is open ("Hide", arrow up): a grey Depth picture ("white = near"), a rainbow-coloured Normals picture ("surface direction") with fine detail, the Detailed normals switch on (yellow), and "512 x 512 px, relief 0.3".

26-detailed-normals-off.jpg.name: detailed-normals-off
26-detailed-normals-off.jpg.about: The same, after turning the Detailed normals switch OFF and waiting for the photo to be analysed again.
26-detailed-normals-off.jpg.see: The same with the Detailed normals switch off (grey). The Normals picture is now smooth lilac with no fine detail, and the shading on the photo is flatter with a thin light outline around the head and shoulders.

27-hold-original.jpg.name: hold-original
27-hold-original.jpg.about: Portrait photo, "Left" preset, while the "Hold to see original" button is held down.
27-hold-original.jpg.see: While the "Hold to see original" button is held: the untouched photo, evenly lit, with a small tag "Original" in its top left corner. The sun and the readouts (x -0.10, y 0.40) do not change.

28-enhance-before.jpg.name: enhance-before
28-enhance-before.jpg.about: Portrait photo, "Left" preset, a mood typed into the Enhance box, before clicking Enhance.
28-enhance-before.jpg.see: Left preset. The ENHANCE box holds the typed words "golden hour". The yellow button reads "Enhance".

29-enhance-running.jpg.name: enhance-running
29-enhance-running.jpg.about: Straight after clicking Enhance, while the job is still running.
29-enhance-running.jpg.see: Top left of the stage: two tabs, "Live preview" (selected) and "Enhancing…" (greyed out). Bottom left: a pill "Enhancing in the background, keep dragging". The yellow button is dimmed and reads "Enhancing…" with a spinner. The sun can still be dragged.

30-enhance-done.jpg.name: enhance-done
30-enhance-done.jpg.about: Enhance finished: the stage has switched to the Enhanced tab with the before/after divider in the middle.
30-enhance-done.jpg.see: The "Enhanced" tab is selected. A vertical white line with a round handle splits the photo in the middle: left half tagged "Live preview", right half tagged "Enhanced". Below: "Download enhanced". In the sidebar the button reads "Enhance again" with a small download button beside it, and "Sweep" is greyed out. There is no sun.

31-enhance-divider-dragged.jpg.name: enhance-divider-dragged
31-enhance-divider-dragged.jpg.about: The Enhanced tab with the round divider handle dragged to the left, a quarter of the way across.
31-enhance-divider-dragged.jpg.see: The same, with the divider line and its round handle a quarter of the way from the left edge, so three quarters of the photo shows the Enhanced side.

32-enhance-back-to-live.jpg.name: enhance-back-to-live
32-enhance-back-to-live.jpg.about: After an Enhance, back on the "Live preview" tab: the button now reads "Enhance again".
32-enhance-back-to-live.jpg.see: The "Live preview" tab is selected again and the sun is back (x -0.10, y 0.40). The "Enhanced" tab can be clicked. The sidebar button still reads "Enhance again" with the download button beside it.

33-sample-portrait.jpg.name: sample-portrait
33-sample-portrait.jpg.about: Straight after clicking the "Portrait" sample thumbnail on the first page: the first frame, nothing else touched.
33-sample-portrait.jpg.see: The astronaut portrait, opened from the "Portrait" thumbnail with no wait. Sun on the flag at the left; readouts x 0.12, y 0.35, Height 0.12, Intensity 1.80, Ambient 0.06. The left of the face is bright, the right cheek in shadow.

34-object-side-light.jpg.name: object-side-light
34-object-side-light.jpg.about: The coffee cup photo with the "Right" preset.
34-object-side-light.jpg.see: Coffee cup with the Right preset. The sun is on the dark stage just right of the photo; readouts x 1.04, y 0.40 (the stage stops it short of 1.10), Height 0.35, Intensity 1.30. The right of the table is bright and the cup's shadow falls to the left.

35-cat-side-light.jpg.name: cat-side-light
35-cat-side-light.jpg.about: The cat photo with the "Left" preset.
35-cat-side-light.jpg.see: Cat with the Left preset. The sun is at the left edge of the stage; readouts x -0.04, y 0.40. The left of the cat's face is bright and the right side, past the nose, is in shadow.

36-dark-photo.jpg.name: dark-photo
36-dark-photo.jpg.about: The dark night-time rocket photo with the "Left" preset.
36-dark-photo.jpg.see: Night rocket with the Left preset; readouts x -0.04, y 0.40. The left faces of the rocket and of the towers are a little brighter, with faint soft shadows to their right on the sky. No hard black bands.

37-tall-photo.jpg.name: tall-photo
37-tall-photo.jpg.about: A tall, narrow photo with the "Left" preset (layout check).
37-tall-photo.jpg.see: A tall, narrow portrait centred in the stage with wide dark margins left and right. Left preset: the sun is on the dark stage left of the photo, readouts x -0.10, y 0.40.

38-wide-photo.jpg.name: wide-photo
38-wide-photo.jpg.about: A wide, short photo with the "Top" preset (layout check).
38-wide-photo.jpg.see: A wide, short strip of the coffee cup centred in the stage with dark margins above and below. Top preset: the sun is on the dark stage above the photo, readouts x 0.50, y -0.15.

39-tiny-photo.jpg.name: tiny-photo
39-tiny-photo.jpg.about: A very small photo (200 x 133 px) with the "Left" preset. It is stretched to fill the stage, so it looks soft.
39-tiny-photo.jpg.see: The cat photo, soft and blurry because a 200 px picture is stretched to fill the stage. Left preset, readouts x -0.04, y 0.40. The shading still works.

40-huge-photo.jpg.name: huge-photo
40-huge-photo.jpg.about: A very large photo (3000 x 3000 px) with the "Left" preset. The app shrinks it before use.
40-huge-photo.jpg.see: The portrait again; it looks the same as 06-preset-left, because the app shrinks a 3000 px photo before using it. Readouts x -0.10, y 0.40.

41-error-not-an-image.jpg.name: error-not-an-image
41-error-not-an-image.jpg.about: A text file was given instead of a picture: a red error appears under the drop box.
41-error-not-an-image.jpg.see: The first page is still showing. Under the four thumbnails is a red bar: "That file is not an image." with an x to close it.
41-error-not-an-image.jpg.error: That file is not an image.

42-backend-offline.jpg.name: backend-offline
42-backend-offline.jpg.about: The first page when the backend is not running: the status pill is red and reads "offline".
42-backend-offline.jpg.see: The first page. Top right pill: red dot, "backend: offline". The four sample thumbnails are still there and still work.
42-backend-offline.jpg.backend: really stopped while this picture was taken
console: log.error: Failed to load resource: net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED http://localhost:8123/health

43-backend-offline-upload.jpg.name: backend-offline-upload
43-backend-offline-upload.jpg.about: A photo chosen while the backend is not running (the failed-load state): the photo is grey and dim under a red-bordered card with "Retry" and "Choose another photo".
43-backend-offline-upload.jpg.see: The photo is grey and dim. A red-bordered card in the middle reads "This photo could not be analysed", then "Cannot reach the backend at http://localhost:8123. Is it running?", with a yellow "Retry" button and a "Choose another photo" button. The sidebar is faded, "Hold to see original" and "Export PNG" are greyed out, and the pill reads "offline".
43-backend-offline-upload.jpg.error: Cannot reach the backend at http://localhost:8123. Is it running?
43-backend-offline-upload.jpg.backend: really stopped while this picture was taken
console: log.error: Failed to load resource: net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED http://localhost:8123/health
log.error: Failed to load resource: net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED http://localhost:8123/relight/scene

44-enhance-error.jpg.name: enhance-error
44-enhance-error.jpg.about: The backend stopped after the photo was loaded, then Enhance was clicked: a red error inside the Enhance panel.
44-enhance-error.jpg.see: The live preview is still there (Left preset). In the ENHANCE panel, under the yellow "Enhance" button, a red bar reads "Cannot reach the backend at http://localhost:8123. Is it running?" with an x. The pill reads "offline".
44-enhance-error.jpg.error: Cannot reach the backend at http://localhost:8123. Is it running?
console: log.error: Failed to load resource: net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED http://localhost:8123/relight/enhance

45-phone-scene.jpg.name: phone-scene
45-phone-scene.jpg.about: A phone-sized window (390 x 844) with the portrait photo loaded: what you see before scrolling.
45-phone-scene.jpg.see: One column. The photo with the sun on the flag, then "Hold to see original" and "Export PNG", then the LIGHT panel straight under the stage: x 0.12, y 0.35, Height 0.12, Intensity 1.80, Ambient 0.06. The helper lines under Height and Ambient show. The pill has no word "backend:", only "online, mock providers".

46-phone-full-page.jpg.name: phone-full-page
46-phone-full-page.jpg.about: The same phone-sized page photographed from top to bottom, as if you scrolled all the way down.
46-phone-full-page.jpg.see: The whole phone page: stage, LIGHT (the "Reset" button wraps onto its own row), ENHANCE with its helper line and a two-row box, and the one-row GEOMETRY panel at the bottom.

47-phone-landing.jpg.name: phone-landing
47-phone-landing.jpg.about: The empty upload page in a phone-sized window.
47-phone-landing.jpg.see: The first page in one column: heading on two lines, the dashed drop box, "Or try a sample photo:" and the four thumbnails in one row.

48-status-checking.jpg.name: status-checking
48-status-checking.jpg.about: Close-up of the status pill in the top right during the first moment after the page opens: grey dot, "checking".
48-status-checking.jpg.see: Grey dot, "backend: checking". It shows for a moment after the page opens.

49-status-online-mock-providers.jpg.name: status-online-mock-providers
49-status-online-mock-providers.jpg.about: Close-up of the status pill when the backend runs with MOCK_MODE=1: amber dot, "online, mock providers".
49-status-online-mock-providers.jpg.tooltip: Backend at http://localhost:8123 (fal: ready, gemini: ready)

50-status-online.jpg.name: status-online
50-status-online.jpg.about: Close-up of the status pill when the backend runs for real (MOCK_MODE=0): green dot, "online".
50-status-online.jpg.tooltip: Backend at http://localhost:8123 (fal: ready, gemini: ready)
50-status-online.jpg.how: The backend was not run with MOCK_MODE=0. Its /health reply was changed on the way to the page.

51-status-offline.jpg.name: status-offline
51-status-offline.jpg.about: Close-up of the status pill when the backend is not running: red dot, "offline".
51-status-offline.jpg.tooltip: Cannot reach the backend at http://localhost:8123
51-status-offline.jpg.backend: really stopped while this picture was taken
console: log.error: Failed to load resource: net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED http://localhost:8123/health

52-no-webgl-fallback.jpg.name: no-webgl-fallback
52-no-webgl-fallback.jpg.about: A browser without WebGL2: a red notice above the stage, and the picture comes from the server instead.
52-no-webgl-fallback.jpg.see: A red bar above the stage: "Live shading is unavailable (WebGL2 is not available in this browser). Showing server renders instead, which lag slightly behind the light." The photo is lit by the server for the Left preset (x -0.10, y 0.40) and looks softer and more even than the live shading. "Hold to see original" and "Export PNG" are available.

53-not-found-page.jpg.name: not-found-page
53-not-found-page.jpg.about: An address that no longer exists ("/autocomplete"): the plain 404 page.
53-not-found-page.jpg.see: A black page with "404" and "This page could not be found." in the middle, under the normal top bar.
console: log.error: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found) http://localhost:3123/autocomplete

54-mock-landing.jpg.name: mock-landing
54-mock-landing.jpg.about: Frontend mock mode (no backend): the first page, status pill yellow "mock".
54-mock-landing.jpg.see: The first page with a yellow dot and "backend: mock" in the pill. Everything else is the same as 01-landing.

55-mock-status.jpg.name: mock-status
55-mock-status.jpg.about: Close-up of the status pill in frontend mock mode: yellow dot, "mock".
55-mock-status.jpg.tooltip: Mock mode: responses are generated in the browser, no backend is called. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_MOCK=0 to use the real one.

56-mock-scene.jpg.name: mock-scene
56-mock-scene.jpg.about: Frontend mock mode with the portrait photo and the "Left" preset: the shading is a made-up round dome, not the real face.
56-mock-scene.jpg.see: An uploaded portrait in frontend mock mode with the Left preset (x -0.10, y 0.40). The shading is one big round dome over the middle of the picture, bright on its left and dark on its right. It does not follow the face.

57-mock-enhance-running.jpg.name: mock-enhance-running
57-mock-enhance-running.jpg.about: Frontend mock mode, straight after clicking Enhance.
57-mock-enhance-running.jpg.see: Frontend mock mode: tabs "Live preview" and "Enhancing…", the pill "Enhancing in the background, keep dragging" at the bottom left, and the dimmed "Enhancing…" button.

58-mock-enhance-done.jpg.name: mock-enhance-done
58-mock-enhance-done.jpg.about: Frontend mock mode after Enhance finished: the right half has more contrast and a soft glow.
58-mock-enhance-done.jpg.see: Frontend mock mode: the Enhanced tab with the divider in the middle. The right half ("Enhanced") has more contrast and a soft glow; the left half is the live preview.

59-sample-thumbnails.jpg.name: sample-thumbnails
59-sample-thumbnails.jpg.about: Close-up of the first page under the drop box: the line "Or try a sample photo:" and the four sample thumbnails.
59-sample-thumbnails.jpg.see: The line "Or try a sample photo:" and four thumbnails in a row, each with its name under it: Portrait (astronaut), Coffee cup, Cat, Rocket.

60-sample-loading.jpg.name: sample-loading
60-sample-loading.jpg.about: The moment after clicking the "Portrait" thumbnail, held still: the other three thumbnails are dimmed while it loads.
60-sample-loading.jpg.see: The first page with the Portrait thumbnail at full brightness and the other three dimmed. In normal use this lasts a fraction of a second.

61-sample-coffee.jpg.name: sample-coffee
61-sample-coffee.jpg.about: Straight after clicking the "Coffee cup" sample thumbnail on the first page: the first frame, nothing else touched.
61-sample-coffee.jpg.see: The coffee cup sample (600 x 400). Sun on the table at the left, x 0.12, y 0.35, Height 0.12, Intensity 1.80, Ambient 0.06. The left of the cup and saucer is bright; the inside of the cup and the area to its right are in shadow.

62-sample-cat.jpg.name: sample-cat
62-sample-cat.jpg.about: Straight after clicking the "Cat" sample thumbnail on the first page: the first frame, nothing else touched.
62-sample-cat.jpg.see: The cat sample. Sun at the left by the ear, x 0.12, y 0.35. The left of the face is bright; the right side, past the nose, is in shadow.

63-sample-rocket.jpg.name: sample-rocket
63-sample-rocket.jpg.about: Straight after clicking the "Rocket" sample thumbnail on the first page: the first frame, nothing else touched.
63-sample-rocket.jpg.see: The night rocket sample. Sun on the left tower, x 0.12, y 0.35. The sky near the sun is lighter, the rocket's left side is lit, and the right of the picture is darker.

64-sample-backend-stopped.jpg.name: sample-backend-stopped
64-sample-backend-stopped.jpg.about: The "Portrait" sample loaded while the backend is not running: the pill reads "offline" and the live preview works all the same.
64-sample-backend-stopped.jpg.see: Pill: red dot, "backend: offline". The Portrait sample is loaded and lit with the Right preset all the same: sun right of the photo, x 1.10, y 0.40, right side of the face bright. No red bar anywhere.
64-sample-backend-stopped.jpg.backend: really stopped while this picture was taken
console: log.error: Failed to load resource: net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED http://localhost:8123/health
log.error: Failed to load resource: net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED http://localhost:8123/health

65-sample-load-error.jpg.name: sample-load-error
65-sample-load-error.jpg.about: The "Cat" sample's files could not be fetched: a red bar appears under the thumbnails and the first page stays.
65-sample-load-error.jpg.see: The first page. Under the thumbnails a red bar reads "Failed to fetch" with an x. No photo opened.
65-sample-load-error.jpg.how: The request for the sample's scene.json was refused inside Chrome. This does not happen in normal use.
console: log.error: Failed to load resource: net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED http://localhost:3123/samples/cat/scene.json

66-sweep-before.jpg.name: sweep-before
66-sweep-before.jpg.about: Portrait sample, before clicking "Sweep": the mouse rests on the Sweep button at the top right of the LIGHT panel.
66-sweep-before.jpg.see: The Portrait sample at its starting light (x 0.12, y 0.35). The "Sweep" button at the top right of the LIGHT panel is slightly lighter because the mouse is on it.
66-sweep-before.jpg.sweepTooltip: Moves the light once around the subject in about six seconds, then gives it back. Handy for recording a demo.

67-sweep-during.jpg.name: sweep-during
67-sweep-during.jpg.about: About two and a half seconds after clicking "Sweep": the light has travelled from the left edge over the top to the right edge, and the button reads "Stop sweep".
67-sweep-during.jpg.see: The button reads "Stop sweep". The sun has moved to the right edge of the photo, about a quarter of the way down (x about 0.93, y about 0.24, changing as you watch). The right side of the face is bright and the left half is dark. The sliders have not moved.

68-sweep-after.jpg.name: sweep-after
68-sweep-after.jpg.about: After the sweep has finished (about six seconds): the light is back where it started and the button reads "Sweep" again.
68-sweep-after.jpg.see: The button reads "Sweep" again and the sun is back on the flag: x 0.12, y 0.35. The picture is the same as before the sweep.

69-geometry-collapsed.jpg.name: geometry-collapsed
69-geometry-collapsed.jpg.about: Close-up of the sidebar with a sample loaded: GEOMETRY is one folded row at the bottom with two tiny thumbnails, the word "Show" and a down arrow.
69-geometry-collapsed.jpg.see: The sidebar only, enlarged: LIGHT (with "Sweep"), ENHANCE, and at the bottom the single row "GEOMETRY" with two tiny thumbnails (grey depth, purple normals), the word "Show" and a down arrow.

70-geometry-expanded.jpg.name: geometry-expanded
70-geometry-expanded.jpg.about: The same after clicking the GEOMETRY row: the panel is open ("Hide", arrow up) with the Depth and Normals pictures, the Detailed normals switch and the size line.
70-geometry-expanded.jpg.see: The sidebar is scrolled to the bottom. GEOMETRY is open: "Hide" and an up arrow, the sentence "What the models recovered from the photo. The shader lights these.", a grey Depth picture of the cup, a purple and green Normals picture, the Detailed normals switch on, and "600 x 400 px, relief 0.3".

71-sample-enhance-done.jpg.name: sample-enhance-done
71-sample-enhance-done.jpg.about: Enhance finished on the "Coffee cup" sample ("Right" preset) with the backend running: the Enhanced tab with the before/after divider.
71-sample-enhance-done.jpg.see: The Enhanced tab on the coffee cup sample: divider in the middle, "Live preview" on the left, "Enhanced" on the right, "Download enhanced" below. Sidebar: x 1.04, y 0.40, the button reads "Enhance again". Pill: "online, mock providers".

72-sample-enhance-backend-stopped.jpg.name: sample-enhance-backend-stopped
72-sample-enhance-backend-stopped.jpg.about: Enhance clicked on the "Coffee cup" sample while the backend is not running: a red bar in the ENHANCE panel, and the live preview stays.
72-sample-enhance-backend-stopped.jpg.see: The coffee cup is still lit live with the Right preset. Under the "Enhance" button a red bar reads "Enhance needs the backend, which cannot be reached at http://localhost:8123. The live preview and Export PNG still work without it." Pill: "offline".
72-sample-enhance-backend-stopped.jpg.error: Enhance needs the backend, which cannot be reached at http://localhost:8123. The live preview and Export PNG still work without it.
72-sample-enhance-backend-stopped.jpg.backend: really stopped while this picture was taken

75-laptop-1280x720-scene.jpg.about: A small laptop window (1280 x 720) with the "Portrait" sample loaded: the whole sidebar fits, down to the GEOMETRY row, with no scrolling.

76-laptop-1280x720-landing.jpg.name: laptop-1280x720-landing

76-laptop-1280x720-landing.jpg.see: The first page fits with no scrolling: heading, a lower drop box, "Or try a sample photo:" and the four thumbnails, with a little space left under them.

77-laptop-1366x768-scene.jpg.name: laptop-1366x768-scene
77-laptop-1366x768-scene.jpg.about: A 1366 x 768 window with an uploaded photo (the coffee cup) and the "Right" preset: the whole sidebar fits without scrolling.
77-laptop-1366x768-scene.jpg.see: The uploaded coffee cup with the Right preset (x 1.05, y 0.40). The sidebar fits without scrolling, in the same compact form as at 1280 x 720: no helper lines, a one-row Enhance box.

78-window-1440x820-scene.jpg.name: window-1440x820-scene
78-window-1440x820-scene.jpg.about: A 1440 x 820 window with the "Portrait" sample: the grey helper lines under Height, Ambient and Cast shadows are not on the page (they are tooltips), but the line under ENHANCE is.
78-window-1440x820-scene.jpg.see: The sidebar fits without scrolling. There are no grey helper lines under Height, Ambient or Cast shadows, but the line "A photoreal pass over this lighting. Takes a few seconds." under ENHANCE is there and the Enhance box has two rows.

79-phone-sample.jpg.name: phone-sample

79-phone-sample.jpg.see: The coffee cup sample on a phone: a short stage that hugs the wide photo, the two buttons under it, and the LIGHT panel starting about half way down the screen with x 0.12, y 0.35 and the helper lines showing.

80-phone-sample-full-page.jpg.name: phone-sample-full-page
80-phone-sample-full-page.jpg.about: The same phone-sized page with the "Coffee cup" sample, photographed from top to bottom with the GEOMETRY panel opened.
